$comment: Declared, non-metered costs. Anything that cannot be pulled from a provider
billing API lives here so the total-cost view is complete and auditable.
- Every entry needs a source: a real invoice or billing page, not a memory.
- `verified_on` is the date the amount was last checked against that source.
The digest flags any entry older than 90 days as stale rather than
silently reporting a number nobody has confirmed this quarter.
- `amount_usd` is per `period`. Annual plans are recorded annually and
amortized by the renderer, not pre-divided here.
- `gross_usd` records metered consumption that is currently absorbed by an
included allowance. It is NOT money today, but it is the leading
indicator of money tomorrow. Never add gross to a spend total; track its
- Set `active: false` rather than deleting, so history stays reconstructable.
TO ADD A COST: copy an entry, fill it in, set verified_on to today.

fixed_costs.label: Claude Max plan (Claude Code seat)
fixed_costs.notes: Flat seat. Claude Code token volume is worth ~$6,071/mo at API list price, so this returns ~28x. Not a cost lever; track capacity instead.

fixed_costs.label: Clerk authentication
fixed_costs.notes: Flat and stable across three consecutive months. Not an optimization target at this size; re-check if MAU growth pushes it into a higher tier.

fixed_costs.label: GitHub (abarva-platform org, metered usage)
fixed_costs.source: github.com/organizations/abarva-platform/settings/billing/usage — Jul 1-22 2026: gross $561.27 cumulative, billed amount $0.00 on every single day
fixed_costs.notes: WATCH THIS. Metered consumption (Actions minutes, storage) is real and growing but currently fully absorbed by the included allowance, so billed cost is zero. Daily gross averaged $21.89 Jul 1-11 vs $33.61 Jul 18-22 — a 1.5x rise, trending to roughly $1,000/month of gross consumption at the recent pace. The moment it exceeds the allowance it converts to real spend with no warning. Track headroom, not just the $0.
